# Changes
## Follow Up view
Don't limit width for the filters, justify center

## New chat modal
 use chatinputbox we need it multiline.
Close modal and let the task to run in background, don't change the current view

**Confirmed:** the Follow-up view already dropped `max-w-6xl`; the New chat modal (`BoardQuickChat.vue`, header reads "New chat") already uses `ChatInputBox` — so the multiline requirement was already met by the composer. **Ruled out:** a second, separate "New chat modal" with a single-line input (no other match in `client/src`). **Next step:** verify in the UI (open New chat, submit, expect the modal to close staying on the board). ## What happened 1. Follow-up view: the header put the title and the filters side by side (`justify-between`), which squeezed the filter row. 2. New chat modal: after submitting, it `await`ed the agent run and emitted `created`, so the dialog stayed open and the view switched to the new chat. ## What I did - `client/src/components/kanban/board/FollowupView.vue`: header is now a vertical stack and the filter row is full width, `justify-center` — no width limit on the filters. - `client/src/components/kanban/board/BoardQuickChat.vue`: `createChat()` now emits `close` right after the card + message are created, no longer emits `created`, and fires `chatWihProject()` in the background without awaiting (errors only logged) — the run continues, the current view is untouched. - Confirmed the composer is `ChatInputBox.vue` (`ref="composer"`), i.e. already multiline. ## Demo
... ...
... // Close the dialog right away and let the work continue in the // background: the current view is never switched to the new chat. this.$emit('close') if (run) { this.$storex.projects .chatWihProject(chat) .catch(error => console.error('[BoardQuickChat] Background run failed:', error)) } Open the Follow-up view in the client (`npm run dev` inside `client/`) and the New chat modal from the board bar. ## Next tasks - `quick` — run the client dev server and eyeball both views (filters centered, modal closes instantly). - `quick` — check whether any parent of `BoardQuickChat` relied on `@created` to refresh the board, and add an explicit refresh if so. - `max` — add a component test for `BoardQuickChat.submit` (closes without awaiting the run). **Good enough?** ok / next / what is wrong > Ops, sorry! There was an error with latest request: name 'tags' is not defined
